import json,os,re
d='/tmp/opensip-design-corrections/claude-author-package-review.v1'

ids=sorted(set(re.findall(r'\bF-?(0[1-9]|1[0-4])\b', s)))
print('F ids present:', ids)
# find the structure holding F findings
def walk(o,path=''):
    if isinstance(o,dict):
        for k,v in o.items():
            if isinstance(v,list) and v and isinstance(v[0],dict) and any('F' in str(x.get('id','')) for x in v[:3]):
                print('FOUND list at', path+'/'+k, 'len', len(v), 'keys', sorted(v[0]))
                return path+'/'+k
            rr=walk(v,path+'/'+k)
            if rr: return rr
    elif isinstance(o,list):
        for i,v in enumerate(o[:8]):
            rr=walk(v,path+'/%d'%i)
            if rr: return rr
walk(r)
